question: How much will a sum of ₹60,000 become after one year if the interest is compounded half-yearly at 18% per annum compound interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹60,000

Rate (r) = 18% per annum compounded half-yearly

Time (t) = 1 year

**Formula used:**

A = P × (1 + r/n)⁽ⁿ × t⁾

Where,

 
• A = Amount
 
• P = Principal
 
• r = Annual Rate of Interest (in decimal)
 
• n = Number of times interest is compounded per year
 
• t = Time (in years)

**Calculations:**

A = 60,000 × (1 + 0.18/2)⁽² × ¹⁾

⇒ A = 60,000 × (1 + 0.09)²

⇒ A = 60,000 × (1.09)²

⇒ A = 60,000 × 1.1881

⇒ A = ₹71,286

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
